annotations.title: A search: state and next step

description: One search: status, progress, counts, credits charged, the estimate (price examples), what to do next (`next`); for a search that asks about a higher price, the question (`ask`). detail=spec adds the requirements as the review screen shows them (criteria with ids, pains, counter-signals, the search method and its options, veins); detail=full adds the brief in full. Poll it while a search compiles or runs. [REST: GET /api/tasks/{id} (+ GET /api/tasks while it runs, GET /api/tasks/{id}/snapshot while it asks)]

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.
